About Creatify

Creatify is building the AI Platform for Advertising where marketers and agents work together to plan campaigns, create ads, manage budgets, and optimize performance across channels.

We've surpassed $10 million in ARR, serving over 3 million users across 10,000+ teams. Leading brands — including AppLovin, Comcast, Perplexity, Alibaba, HubSpot, Binance, and NewsBreak— use Creatify to produce personalized, high-performing video ads in minutes.

We have raised $24M in funding from leading Silicon Valley firms including WndrCo, Kindred Ventures, Millennium New Horizons, NFDG, Comcast Ventures, Creator Ventures, Leadout Capital, Hat Trick Capital, and many more. Check out our latest coverage by Fast Company, TechCrunch, Bloomberg TV, and our recognition as one of IVP Enterprise AI 55 in 2024.

Based in Mountain View, we are a team of passionate AI researchers, engineers, and advertising veterans. Join us in reinventing the advertising industry with AI.


ABOUT THIS ROLE

We're hiring a full-stack engineer. We're open to professionals with a few years of experience and ambitious new graduates. In this role, you'll work closely with our CTO and other engineers to develop and shape Creatify's industry-leading AI video ad solution.

This is a full-time, in-person position based in Mountain View, CA.




RESPONSIBILITIES

As a Senior Full-stack Developer at Creatify, you'll be responsible for creating responsive web designs, coding frontends and backends, and collaborating with PMs and designers to deliver features. This is a full-time and in-person role, based in Mountain View, CA.




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of full-stack development experience.

 - Proficiency in React, Python, and frameworks like Django or Flask.

 - Familiarity with Docker, SQL, and cloud services like AWS, GCP, or Azure.

 - Previous experience in video, ads, AI is a significant plus.

 - Fast-paced work style. We operate at a high speed, and so should you.

 - Excellent communication, teamwork skills, and problem-solving ability.

 - A genuinely nice person.

We are an equal opportunity employer and highly value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
